decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the erection of  a  rear extension to this   
     dwellinghouse, because of its position, design and appearance, would be  
     acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 28 
     Highfield Road and is complimentary to the visual amenity of the locality and 
     would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring 
     properties and will preserve the character of the Spring Grove Conservation  
     Area.    The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New
     Development)  and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough 
     of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and west walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
